question: Does learned sparse contrastive causal energy from paired interventions improve held cross-context transfer over strong fully fitted conventional baselines, without old-context loss or excessive compute?
hypothesis: When a previously unobserved binary intervention dimension is crossed by 16 training bridges, pair-delta max-margin constraints will improve disjoint other-side predictions over all matched learned controls and the no-pair energy ablation, while retaining base-side knowledge.
predecessor_evidence: ENERGY-34 DEVEL_NO_GO: x0=0 only training led nonidentifiability on x0=1 held; energy 2709/4608 versus OMP 2862/4608.
status: FROZEN BEFORE PRIMARY; only excluded smoke seed 99079 assessed, two pre-freeze contrast weights (.75/.15 then .20/.02), no primary seed run.

inputs.name: Self-authored SHA256-keyed eight-bit causal-intervention world generator
inputs.source: Original local synthetic public code; no external data or protected model checkpoint.

frozen_design.split: Per source (seed, world, family): independently hash-sort 128 x0=0 action patterns, take first 80 as common fitting interventions, next 16 as no_bridge substituted x0=0, next 16 as x0=0 held; in bridge16 use the x0=1 flips of first 16 common actions as 16 new training interventions instead of substituted 16 x0=0; held x0=1 are first 48 hash-sorted not among bridge actions; held same for both regimes; no overlap.
frozen_design.ordering: SHA256 hash prefix energy35-v1; noise 0.10 independently per unique intervention; 96 experienced actions per arm and world. Hidden rule chosen from signed 3-factor majority in predeclared 190 dimensional parity/AND dictionary.
frozen_design.data_budget: 3 seeds * 8 world ids * 3 families * 2 regimes =144 worlds; 96 witnessed intervention/outcome labels per world; 64 disjoint held predictions (16 original x0=0 / 48 shifted x0=1); 16 paired counterfactual bridge interventions only in bridge16; no_bridge gets 16 alternative x0=0 labels at equal 96 label budget; controls within each regime get exact identical observations.
frozen_design.compute_budget: 48 fixed paired/plain energy passes; 8 gradient coordinates per pass; support<=12; OMP12 n_nonzero=12; logistic max_iter=500 tol 1e-8, C=1; ridge alpha=3; SVC C=2 gamma=scale; decision tree depth<=8. No paid models, CPU only. Time each full fit + held prediction within arm; record whole run seconds separately.
frozen_design.capacity: 190 fixed features accessible to energy, OMP and ridge/logistic; <=12 energy/OMP learned support. SVM/tree are strong conventional non-matched-capacity controls and their larger capacity must be disclosed.
frozen_design.evaluator: E(y|x)=-y w dot phi(x); predict class 1 iff score>0 else -1; score noise-free causal bit separately on 16 x0=0 and 48 x0=1 held actions. Source true rule, factor IDs and noise remain evaluator-only. x0 context is specified to learner by observed intervention bits only; no hidden regime target labels.
frozen_design.runtime: Python 3.13.5, NumPy 2.3.5, scikit-learn 1.8.0, Linux CPU, OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1

controls: Plain sparse-energy same 48 epochs and support<=12 without pair contrastive gradients
Paired OMP12 with 16 additional label-difference training rows derived only from same observed 96 labels
Paired Ridge with same derivative rows from the 96 labels
Fully fitted L2 logistic regression on same dictionary
Fully fitted RBF SVM on raw action bits
Fully fitted depth-8 decision tree on raw action bits
no_bridge policy uses same 96 total observed consequences, different interventions, no x0=1 action; not a paired algorithm comparison
metrics: Shifted held correct out of 72 worlds*48=3456 per regime
Old held correct out of 72*16=1152 per regime
Per-seed shift margins against best fully fitted conventional control
Bridge16 vs no_bridge energy shifted accuracy
Aggregate per-arm wall component time, complete process wall time

classification_rules.supported: DEVELOPMENT_GO iff all seven frozen gates pass, but scientific acceptance and energy-specific speedup still require independent native qualification.
classification_rules.mixed: Explicitly report which individual development gates pass and which fail; no selective promotion.
classification_rules.negative: DEVELOPMENT_NO_GO if any gate fails; stop this candidate rather than tune primary seeds.
classification_rules.invalid: Missing commit-before-score, source/seed mismatch, evidence/control leakage, missing strong baselines, or unreproducible primary receipts. Distinguish infrastructure failures from science.

gates.shift_vs_strongest: In bridge16, paired-energy x0=1 held correct must exceed MAX over OMP12, paired OMP12, paired Ridge, logistic, RBF-SVM and decision tree by >=3pp (denominator 3456).
gates.old_retention: In bridge16, paired-energy x0=0 held correct must be within 1pp of strongest conventional control old accuracy (denominator 1152).
gates.contrast_ablation: In bridge16, paired-energy must gain >=2pp on shifted held over same-source plain-energy ablation.
gates.bridge_value: Paired-energy bridge16 must gain >=5pp on shifted held against equal-observation-budget paired-energy no_bridge.
gates.seed_stability: Positive shifted margin against strongest conventional control in at least 2 of the 3 source seeds.
gates.shuffled_control: In bridge16, paired-energy shifted correct strictly exceeds shuffled-label paired-energy.
gates.fit_cost: Measured aggregate paired-energy fit+held-predict component time <=1.5 times fastest fully trained conventional control in bridge16; this cannot alone claim whole-process speedup.
